# Carpenterwala

> Carpenterwala is Bangalore's premier verified home improvement marketplace connecting homeowners directly with background-checked carpenters, painters, plumbers, and electricians at 0% platform commission.

## Core Services
- [Carpentry Services](https://carpenterwala.com/services/carpentry): Custom furniture assembly, modular kitchen fitting, door lock installation, hydraulic hinge replacement, wardrobe repairs.
- [Painting Services](https://carpenterwala.com/services/painting): Interior and exterior wall painting, texture accent walls, waterproofing, damp-proof putty treatment.
- [Plumbing Services](https://carpenterwala.com/services/plumbing): Tap & faucet replacement, pipe leak repair, water heater installation, overhead water tank deep cleaning, kitchen drain unclogging.
- [Electrical Services](https://carpenterwala.com/services/electrical): Switchboard fitting, MCB trip diagnostics, fuse repair, house rewiring, ceiling fan & light fixture installation.

## Interactive Tools & Calculators
- [Paint Cost & Quantity Estimator](https://carpenterwala.com/services/painting#calculator): Estimates wall painting square footage, primer requirement, litres of paint, and labor costs for 1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK flats in Bangalore.
- [Water Wastage & Tap Drip Calculator](https://carpenterwala.com/services/plumbing#calculator): Calculates daily and monthly water loss (in litres and ₹ Rupees) caused by leaking taps, flush tanks, and pipes in Indian households.
- [Electricity Wastage & Bill Calculator](https://carpenterwala.com/services/electrical#calculator): Estimates monthly kWh power consumption, electrical wastage, and electricity bill impacts for appliances (fans, ACs, geysers, refrigerators).

## Standard Labor Rate Cards in Bangalore
- **Carpentry**: Door lock fitting (₹250–₹450), Modular kitchen hydraulic hinge repair (₹180–₹350), Custom wardrobe assembly (₹600–₹1,200).
- **Painting**: 1 BHK interior repainting (₹4,500–₹7,500), 2 BHK repainting (₹8,000–₹13,000), Damp-proofing putty (₹18–₹32/sq ft).
- **Plumbing**: Tap/faucet replacement (₹150–₹300), Overhead water tank cleaning (₹650–₹1,200), Kitchen drain unclogging (₹200–₹400).
- **Electrical**: Switchboard repair (₹120–₹250), MCB trip diagnostics (₹200–₹450), Ceiling fan installation (₹150–₹300).

## Verification & Trust Signals
- **Identity & Background Checks**: Mandatory Aadhaar verification and police background verification for all listed professionals.
- **Direct Marketplace**: 0% platform commission; homeowners connect and pay directly with zero hidden markups.
- **Rapid Dispatch**: Verified handymen arrive within 60 to 90 minutes across all serviced Bangalore clusters.

## Model Context Protocol (MCP) & AI Agent Integration
Carpenterwala exposes a Remote WebMCP server and OpenAPI 3.1 specification for autonomous AI agents (Google Gemini on Android, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI ChatGPT, and Perplexity).

- **Remote WebMCP Server (JSON-RPC 2.0 / SSE)**: `https://carpenterwala.com/api/mcp`
- **OpenAPI 3.1 Specification**: `https://carpenterwala.com/api/mcp/openapi.json`
- **REST Tool Execution Endpoint**: `https://carpenterwala.com/api/mcp/tools/{toolName}`

### Available AI Agent Tools
1. `initiate_technician_onboarding`:
   - **For Service Technicians**: Initiates registration for carpenters, painters, plumbers, and electricians with 0% platform commission.
   - **Privacy Safeguard**: Returns a secure, encrypted 1-click mobile verification link. Technicians verify mobile OTP and upload KYC credentials directly on their device; sensitive documents and OTPs are never exposed in 3rd-party AI chat transcripts.
   - **Rate Limit**: Maximum 3 onboarding attempts per 24 hours per phone number.
   - **Parameters**: `name` (string), `phone` (10-digit), `trade` (string), `location` (string), `experienceYears` (number, optional).

2. `check_technician_application_status`:
   - Checks onboarding verification or active badge status by registered 10-digit mobile number.
   - **Parameters**: `phone` (10-digit string).

3. `search_verified_pros`:
   - Finds verified background-checked tradesmen by trade and Bangalore locality.
   - **Parameters**: `trade` ("carpentry"|"painting"|"plumbing"|"electrical"), `locality` (optional), `limit` (optional).

4. `get_service_rate_card`:
   - Returns standard zero-commission Bangalore labor price cards and task durations.
   - **Parameters**: `serviceCategory` ("carpentry"|"painting"|"plumbing"|"electrical"), `jobType` (optional).

5. `calculate_service_estimate`:
   - Runs instant calculations for wall painting area & paint liters, leaking tap water loss, or appliance electrical bill wastage.
   - **Parameters**: `calculatorType` ("paint_cost"|"water_wastage"|"electricity_bill"), `params` (object).

6. `request_service_callback`:
   - Dispatches a quick homeowner repair request to nearby verified pros with 60-90 min response time.
   - **Parameters**: `customerName`, `customerPhone`, `trade`, `locality`, `description`.
